name: Overhead recipe step sequence

source.description: Genre convention: overhead (flat-lay) recipe videos with ingredients listed, then numbered steps with the cooking vessel as the anchor.

technique: Ingredient list assembles, numbered steps replace each other around a constant vessel, final serve shot holds.

decomposition.timing: Step holds sized to reading time

licensing_notes: Technique only. No specific artwork, footage, characters or compositions from any source are copied.
